subject: NicheMapR shiny apps for Australia now linked to ERA5

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: NicheMapR shiny apps for Australia now linked to ERA5
parts:
Hi everyone,
Hope your year is off to a good start.

If you're working on Australian sites and using the shiny apps, I've just linked the soil_oz and ectotherm_oz apps to the ERA5 data.

Before they were only linked to the Australian Gridded Climate Data aka Australian Water Availability Project daily grids which go from 1911 to present. However, the BoM stopped providing free access to these datasets since about 2020.

The ERA5 data is hourly rather than daily but ~30km res rather than 5km. I've downloaded all the ERA5 data for Australia and put it on my server that runs the apps. It's about 5gig per year and goes from 1979 to about 3 months before present, though at the moment the apps work until the end of 2021. You can specifically choose which data set to use but the app will switch to one or the other if you ask for a year that isn't available for the specified data set.

Overall, the ERA5 predictions are extremely similar to the AGCD/AWAP ones and are probably superior given that the ERA5 data captures the hourly covariances among the weather conditions.

All the best,
Mike
